title: Integrate new BunkPro logo set with theme-aware variants and updated favicon

requirements.summary: Add the newly generated BunkPro logo set (icon + horizontal wordmark) with dark/light variants as static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Four logo images are produced as static assets (icon + horizontal wordmark) with both dark-background and light-background variants.
Logos are flat/minimal (no heavy 3D), avoid mascots/playful fonts/too many colors/complex illustrations.
Primary color uses deep purple #6C4DFF or an indigo gradient; secondary colors are soft white/light gray; any accent glow is subtle and does not reduce legibility.
The icon remains clearly recognizable when rasterized/viewed at 48×48.
Typography matches: modern sans-serif, geometric/rounded feel; “Bunk” visually heavier than “Pro”; tagline text exactly “Track Smart.” appears in the full logo variant.

file_operations.description: Add the generated light-background app icon asset as a static file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated dark-background app icon asset as a static file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated horizontal logo (light-background) with wordmark and tagline “Track Smart.” as a static file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated horizontal logo (dark-background) with wordmark and tagline “Track Smart.” as a static file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Wire the new logo assets into existing branding placements (Initial loading splash and Settings → About) with theme-aware dark/light selection.
acceptanceCriteria: All new logo files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced via absolute paths (e.g., /assets/generated/...).
Initial loading splash and Settings → About display the new logo, with a dark-variant used in dark mode and a light-variant used in light mode.
No remaining UI surfaces show the previous generated logo file path(s).

file_operations.description: Update the splash screen to display the new logo (prefer the icon-only variant) and choose between dark/light assets based on the current theme, using absolute paths under /assets/generated/. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update Settings → About to display the new horizontal wordmark variant and choose between dark/light assets based on the current theme, using absolute paths under /assets/generated/. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

If needed to avoid duplicating theme detection logic, pass theme context (or a derived isDark boolean) down to InitialLoadSplash so it can reliably select the correct logo variant. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update branding constants to use the exact tagline “Track Smart.” and support theme-aware logo selection via stable immutable paths.
acceptanceCriteria: The displayed tagline in Settings → About is exactly “Track Smart.”.
Branding constants provide a clear way to retrieve the correct logo asset for dark vs light mode (used by splash and about views).
No changes are made to any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing single logoPath and tagline with theme-aware asset references (light/dark) for icon and horizontal logo, and set the tagline to exactly “Track Smart.”. Ensure callers can retrieve the correct absolute /assets/generated/... path without changing any immutable paths. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update AboutCard to source the tagline from the updated BRANDING constants and render exactly “Track Smart.” in the UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a new favicon derived from the new app icon and ensure index.html references it under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: A 32×32 PNG favicon asset is present under frontend/public/assets/generated.
frontend/index.html references the new favicon file path.
Browser tab icon updates to the new design after reload (with normal cache-busting expectations during development).

file_operations.description: Add the generated 32×32 PNG favicon derived from the new app icon as a static asset. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the favicon <link> references /assets/generated/bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png (and update it if it points elsewhere). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
